title: Bounded Prefix Construction
statement: Let $l$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a Boolean input word with input-head position $p$, let $w_i$ be a Boolean word for each counter $i<l$, and let $r$ be a record word. Suppose every counter word has length at most $W$. For each $j\le l$, there is a time $t\le j(3W+4)$ at which the row controller, started with its field index and copier control both zero, is in field index $j$ with copier control zero; its input position, counter-tape contents and head positions agree with their initial values, and its record is $r$ followed by the stored prefix of the first $j$ counter words.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a valid input-head position for $x$
$w$ assigns a Boolean word to each of the $l$ counter indices
each counter word has length at most $W$
replaced: For every input word, input position, counter words all of length at most $W$, record, and count $j \le l$, there is a time $t \le j(3W + 4)$ after which the row controller, started at field zero, has appended exactly the stored prefix of the first $j$ fields to the record and sits at field index $j$ with every counter and head restored.
